welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: This is the admin dashboard template: a starting point for internal admin dashboards. The shell, design system, data layer, and sign-in flow are done; copy it, point it at your backend, and start building screens.
welcome.stack: React 19 · TypeScript · Vite · React Router 7 · Redux Toolkit · react-hook-form · SCSS
welcome.devOnly: You are looking at the showcase. It appears only while the dev server runs and never ships in a production build.

includes.title: What you get
items: Sign in, forgot password, and reset password from an emailed link.
A responsive shell: a sidebar that shows only what the admin's role allows, a light and dark switch, and route guards that explain instead of showing a blank 403.
A reference feature to copy: /admins (search, sort, pagination, row menu, modals) and /account (name, password, sign out).
A component kit — buttons, fields, dropdowns, a date picker, tables, modals, side panels, toasts — keyboard-complete and themed.

rename.title: 2. Make it yours
rename.description: Each of these takes a minute.
rows: src/styles/_variables.scss (try them in the brand playground first)

backend.title: 3. Connect your backend
backend.description: Copy the env file and set VITE_API_BASE_URL to your API.
needs: The auth and admin endpoints listed in src/api/iam.ts.
A JWT whose payload has sub, isSuperAdmin, permissions, and exp.
This app's origin in the backend's CORS allow-list — otherwise the app says "Cannot reach the API".

showcase.title: 4. Keep or remove the showcase
showcase.description: Keeping it costs nothing, because production builds leave it out. To remove it, delete src/presentation-data/ and its two hook-ins in App.tsx and Sidebar.tsx — both are marked by import.meta.env.DEV.

firstScreen.title: Build your first screen
firstScreen.description: For a new backend module, in this order:
steps: API — src/api/<module>.ts with one function per endpoint; mirror DTOs and enums in src/api/types.ts.
State — thunks in src/redux/actions/, a slice in src/redux/features/, registered in store.ts.
Page — copy src/pages/AdminsPage.tsx; text goes in src/i18n/en.json, numbers in src/pages/constants.ts.
Route and nav — App.tsx and components/nav.ts, with the same permission gate the backend uses.
Check — npm run build && npm run lint, then try it against the backend.
firstScreen.tip: Before writing a new component, look through the showcase — the kit probably has it.

login.title: Sign in screen
login.description: What a signed-out admin sees first. The form validates like the real one, but submitting it signs no one in.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password screen
forgotPassword.description: Requests a reset email. Submitting shows the same confirmation toast the real screen shows.

resetPassword.title: Reset password screen
resetPassword.description: Opened from the emailed link. It shows the form for a valid link and a message for a missing or expired one.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Every button the kit ships. Pick a variant by what the action means, not by how it looks.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: One Button component, one variant per intent. secondary is the default when no variant is passed.

primary.label: Save
primary.note: The one main action of a screen or dialog: submit, create, confirm.

secondary.label: Export
secondary.note: The default. A neutral action that sits next to a primary one.

outline.label: Cancel
outline.note: Backing out of a dialog, or a secondary action on a card. Rounder and lighter than secondary.

ghost.label: Show more
ghost.note: Lowest emphasis: no border, no fill. For toolbars and inline actions.

danger.label: Remove
danger.note: A destructive action that is not final yet, usually one that opens a confirmation.

danger-outline.label: Sign out
danger-outline.note: A destructive or session-ending action placed among neutral ones.

danger-soft.label: Delete
danger-soft.note: A compact destructive action inside dense UI such as a card. Keeps its own padding at every size.

danger-solid.label: Delete
danger-solid.note: The confirm button of a destructive dialog, once the user has seen what will be lost.

warning-solid.label: Disable
warning-solid.note: The confirm button of a reversible but disruptive dialog, such as disable or suspend.

states.title: Sizes and states
states.description: Every variant at its default size, small, disabled, and busy. Busy is disabled with a label that says what is happening.

composition.title: Icons and width
composition.description: Icons are passed as children and sized by the button. fullWidth stretches the button to its container, as on the sign-in screens.
composition.leadingIconNote: Icon before the label for create actions.
composition.trailingIconNote: Icon after the label for forward steps.
composition.fullWidthNote: Fills its container. Used for the submit button of auth screens.

iconButtons.title: Icon buttons
iconButtons.description: A square button with an icon and no visible label. It is a class, not a component, and always needs an aria-label.
iconButtons.closeNote: Top corner of a dismissible modal or a side panel.
iconButtons.editNote: An inline edit control, as in the sidebar footer.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Every field the kit ships. Labels, hints, and errors come from Field, so every input lines up the same way.

textField.title: Text field
textField.description: A labelled input. Pass hint for guidance and error once the field is touched.
textField.label: Full name
textField.withPlaceholder: A placeholder is an example, never a replacement for the label.
textField.required: Adds the required mark and aria-required.
textField.withHint: Guidance under the field, with an info icon.
textField.withError: Red border, error text, and aria-invalid.

passwordField.title: Password field
passwordField.description: A text field with a reveal toggle. Use autoComplete so password managers fill it correctly.
passwordField.label: Password
passwordField.error: Use an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a symbol.
passwordField.default: The eye button shows and hides the value.
passwordField.withHint: New passwords show the complexity rule up front.
passwordField.hintAndError: With both a hint and an error, the hint turns red and the error text is not shown.

textarea.title: Text area
textarea.description: Multi-line text. Wrap a textarea with the textarea class in Field.
textarea.label: Notes
textarea.placeholder: Anything the next admin should know

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A bordered checkbox row. Put several in a checkbox-grid to lay them out in columns.
checkbox.gridNote: Options laid out in responsive columns.

dropdown.title: Dropdown
dropdown.description: Single choice from a list. Type to filter; arrow keys, Enter, and Escape work as expected.
dropdown.label: Role
dropdown.hint: Pick the access level this admin starts with.
dropdown.default: Filters the options locally as you type.
dropdown.chip: A compact pill for filter bars.
dropdown.inField: Wrapped in Field for a label and a hint, as in a form.
dropdown.disabled: Shows the value and cannot be opened.

multiDropdown.title: Multi dropdown
multiDropdown.description: Several choices from a list. The trigger shows how many are selected.
multiDropdown.label: Roles
multiDropdown.default: Selections are applied as they are checked.

datePicker.title: Date picker
datePicker.description: A calendar in a popover. Single values go through value and onChange; a range is written to the URL.
datePicker.withTimeNote: Adds hour, minute, and AM or PM.
datePicker.rangeNote: Two days, stored in the URL, as a list filter.

search.title: Search
search.description: The search box of a list screen. It writes search to the URL after a short pause and resets the page.
search.default: The info icon lists the fields the backend searches.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Every icon the kit ships. They are inline SVG components, so they inherit the text colour and take their size from CSS.
icons.usage: Import an icon by name and render it as a tag. It draws with currentColor, so it matches whatever holds it. Click an icon to copy its tag.
icons.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

tables.title: Tables
tables.description: The Table component in every shape a list screen uses. Sorting, search, and paging live in the URL, so every view here is linkable.

list.title: List screen
list.description: Search, sortable columns, a row menu, clickable rows, and pagination wired together the way AdminsPage does it. Sort a column or change page and watch the URL.

actions.title: Row actions
actions.description: Buttons at the end of each row. An icon action needs a label for screen readers; tone sets its colour, and text turns it into a labelled button.

states.title: States
states.description: What a table shows before, between, and instead of rows. The page only passes isLoading, error, and emptyMessage.
states.loading: First load: skeleton rows while there is nothing to show yet.
states.refreshing: Refreshing: existing rows stay and dim while the next page loads.
states.empty: Empty: the emptyMessage you pass, filtered or not.
states.error: Error: the request failed and the table shows why.
states.errorMessage: Cannot reach the API. Is the backend running?

modals.title: Modals
modals.description: Every overlay the kit ships. Each one traps Tab, closes on Escape and on a click outside, and hands focus back to the button that opened it.

dialogs.title: Dialogs
dialogs.description: Modal with an icon, a tone, a title, and a description. The buttons go in a modal-actions row as children.
dialogs.confirmNote: A plain confirmation for a change that is easy to undo.
dialogs.dangerNote: Destructive and final. The confirm button is danger-solid.
dialogs.successNote: Tells the admin something worked when a toast is too easy to miss.
dialogs.warningNote: Reversible but disruptive, such as disabling an account.
dialogs.infoNote: Read-only content the admin can close with the X in the corner.

confirm.title: Change this admin’s role?
confirm.description: Ben Carter will become Manager. This takes effect immediately.

danger.title: Delete this admin?
danger.description: Ani Petrosyan loses access immediately and their sessions end. This cannot be undone.

success.title: Invitation sent
success.description: We emailed a sign-in link to chloe.martin@example.com. It expires in 24 hours.

warning.title: Disable this account?
warning.description: David Kim cannot sign in until the account is enabled again. Their data is kept.

info.title: About roles
info.description: Admins manage everything, managers run day-to-day work, viewers read only, and auditors read logs. Permissions are read from the token when an admin signs in.

forms.title: Form in a modal
forms.description: A wide modal holding a form, laid out with modal-form. The dropdown inside it shows the layering: Escape closes the open dropdown first, then the modal.
forms.note: Validates on touch and enables submit once the form is valid.

form.title: Add admin
form.roleHint: Pick the access level this admin starts with.

panels.title: Side panel and pop-up
panels.description: SidePanel slides in from the right for details next to a list. PopUp is a small card anchored to the button that opened it.
panels.panelNote: Details of one record. Its delete button opens a modal on top, and Escape closes the modal before the panel.
panels.popUpNote: A quick input next to its trigger. Closes on Escape or a click outside.

popUp.label: Add a note
popUp.title: Add a note
popUp.description: Notes are visible to every admin.

filters.title: Filter bar
filters.description: PageActions is the bar above a list. Pass it what the backend can filter by and it renders the controls and keeps every value in the URL.

bar.title: Everything at once
bar.description: Search, a single-choice filter, a multi-choice filter, a date range, and toggles. Every change resets the page to 1.

url.title: What the page reads
url.description: The list page reads these from the URL with usePageActionParams and passes them to the thunk. Reload or share the link and the filters come back.
url.empty: No filters set. Change a control above.

view.title: View toggle
view.description: PageViewToggle switches between layouts of the same data and stores the choice in the view parameter. The first option is the default and is left out of the URL.
view.label: Layout

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: How the app tells the admin what happened, what is loading, and what is missing.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: An inline message that stays on the page. Error is announced to screen readers immediately; the others politely.
alerts.error: Could not load the admins. Try again in a moment.
alerts.warning: Your role does not include this permission. Ask the super admin to change it.
alerts.errorNote: Something failed. Announced to screen readers right away.
alerts.successNote: Confirms a change on the page that made it.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: A short message in the corner after an action. Each tone stays a little longer than the last, so errors are hardest to miss.
toasts.warningMessage: The export may take a few minutes.
toasts.failureNote: notifyFailure shows the server's message, or this fallback when there is none.

loading.title: Loading and empty
loading.description: What a screen shows before it has data, and when there is none.
loading.spinner: Spinner with a label, for a section that is loading.
loading.customNote: Pass a label that says what is happening.
loading.empty: Nothing here yet. Create the first record to see it listed.
loading.emptyNote: A quiet message where content would be.

skeletons.title: Skeletons
skeletons.description: Placeholders shaped like the content that is on its way. Tables use them for the first load.
skeletons.animations: Left to right: wave (the default), pulse, and no animation.

hints.title: Tooltips and truncation
hints.description: Extra detail on demand. Both work with a mouse, the keyboard, and touch.
hints.tooltipContent: Managers can approve refunds and invite viewers, but cannot change roles.
hints.tooltipNote: An info icon that explains a field or a column.
hints.truncated: This note is far too long to fit in the narrow column it lives in, so it is cut short and the full text is one hover away.
hints.truncatedNote: Long text in a narrow space. An info icon appears only when the text is cut.

tokens.title: Design tokens
tokens.description: The values every stylesheet is built from. Colours change with the theme; everything else is fixed. Add new ones to _variables.scss, never as a literal in a component.

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: Read with m.token("name") in SCSS. Both themes are shown side by side whichever one is active.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Gaps and padding, as v.$space-* in SCSS.

fontSizes.title: Font sizes
fontSizes.description: As v.$font-size-* in SCSS. Headings set their own sizes in _base.scss.

shadows.title: Shadows
shadows.description: Theme tokens, so they get darker in dark mode.

breakpoints.title: Breakpoints
breakpoints.description: Use @include m.respond-below("name"), never a raw media query.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Use z-index: m.z("name"). Anything that must appear over a modal uses popup or above.
